decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a publicly rebranded continuation of a well-established trommel screen, so the investment and visible commitment remain high and it fits the core mobile screening business.

The multi-model flail shredder line was presented on its own page and represents substantial sunk development, so management would attribute any weak results to pandemic-related market disruption and persist.

Even though it was only mentioned on the website and the related green-waste grinder line was already withdrawn, this multi-model grinder line still fits the mobile processing strategy, so management would likely justify keeping it.

The single electric fine shredder has low visibility and modest sunk cost, but it matches the announced resource-saving, electrified direction, and weak results can be blamed on temporary market conditions.
The stationary pre-shredder line has its own page and underpins the firm's announced push into tougher stationary processing, so commitment to it remains strong.
